text:
incidents-bot: ALERT — Dedicated pool ‘us-west-2/dedicated-gpu-pool-7’ p99 latency > 2.5s for 5m. SLO breach threshold crossed. Paging oncall-rotation :rotating_light:

alex: seeing it on dashboards too. p95 ~ 420ms, p99 ~ 2.7s, streaming stalls reported.

maria: queue depth spiked to 4200, pool shows 0 warm nodes available, autoscaler reports pending scale-up.

deepak: looked at autoscaler logs, backoff loop: "scale_request_sent" but new nodes stuck in warmup for ~90s each. Typical warmup target is 20-30s.

sam: @oncall-rotation please take — customers might see degraded chat streaming (partial tokens/pauses).

oncall-rotation: taking. quick summary of impact? which products/tenants?

alex: multi-tenant dedicated customers thrown into fallback lane; high-priority requests are queueing. We have 7 active customers impacted, top two showing user-visible stalls.

maria: metrics snippet: p95=0.42s, p99=2.72s, error-rate ~0.3% spikes related to streaming reconnects. KV cache cold-hit rate jumped 5x.

jin: adding logs from router:
```
[2026-03-15T12:02:43Z] route=dedicated-gpu-pool-7 queue_depth=4210 live_sessions=129 stream_stalls=23
[2026-03-15T12:02:44Z] autoscaler: desired=8 current=4 scaling_in_progress=true request_id=aa3f
[2026-03-15T12:02:45Z] warmup: gpu_init=out_of_band 1 nodes failed warmup, duration=88s
```

deepak: root cause hypothesis — autoscaler handshake delay + slow warmup of model artifacts (large weights, quantized conversion) causing effective capacity shortfall during the burst. Also prefix cache coldstarting -> longer token generation for first requests.

sam: Can we route to a compatible smaller model to reduce p99 while scale-up completes? Any perf delta?

alex: Yes, we have a compatible 4-bit quantized variant with lower latency. Tradeoff: slight quality regression but acceptable for short mitigation.

oncall-rotation: Actions I will run now:
1) Promote fallback route to lower-latency model for client tier=prod_high for 10m
2) Manually request immediate capacity bump + mark warmup priority
3) Notify customers and update status page

maria: command to force priority warmup:
```
rwictl pool warmup --pool dedicated-gpu-pool-7 --priority high --nodes 4
```
(ran by infra only)

deepak: manual scale request submitted, autoscaler acknowledged but some nodes returning "artifact_fetch_slow" in logs. Pushing small workaround: prefetch artifacts to node init container.

jin: I flipped the routing rule to fallback model for the impacted tenant group: route change id=chg-9834. Observed immediate drop in p99 from 2.7s -> 1.0s for those requests.

oncall-rotation: Noted. Customer comms draft: "We’re investigating increased latency in dedicated capacity during a burst; we’ve routed affected traffic to a lower-latency model while additional capacity warms up. We expect full restoration within 15-20 minutes." Post to status? :+1:

alex: We're seeing streaming stalls reduce but tail still elevated. p99 now ~1.05s cluster-wide after partial mitigations. Queue depth down to 1200.

sam: Are there errors from gateway timeouts or just slow responses?

maria: Mostly slow responses and a few client reconnects; no widespread 5xx. error-rate trending down.

deepak: Follow-ups: add prefetch step to warmup pipeline, reduce model artifact conversion on first-run (cache quantized bin), and improve autoscaler handshake timeout detection. I’ll file infra tickets.

jin: Recording mitigation timeline for postmortem: 12:02 alert -> 12:04 manual scale -> 12:06 routing fallback -> 12:10 p99 improved -> 12:25 autoscaler completed + nodes warm -> 12:30 rollback fallback.

oncall-rotation: I’ll keep monitoring for next 30m. Owners: deepak (infra warmup fixes), maria (telemetry + status), alex (customer comms), jin (rollback + routing rules). Anyone else?

sam: add SRE-runbook note: consider temporary increase of warmup concurrency and lower artifact compaction during bursts.

alex: Customer impact assessment: 7 tenants affected, two reported user-visible stalls; SLA window breached for ~11 minutes for p99>2s for those tenants. Logging contact with account teams now.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — status: mitigated (partial). p99 reduced to ~1.05s for impacted routes. Follow-up tasks created: RWI-2451 (warmup-prefetch), RWI-2452 (autoscaler-handshake), RWI-2453 (fallback-routing playbook).

oncall-rotation: closing oncall handoff — will hand to next rotation in 25m if stable. Marking postmortem owner: deepak + maria.

alex: thanks all. quick retro note: prioritize a short-circuit fallback for streaming so we avoid partial token stalls during model switch.

maria: adding eval tests for fallback quality delta so sales/customer success can approve fallback for emergency use.

deepak: logging the artifact fetch root cause details into RWI-2451 and attaching logs.

jin: Closing thread when next checkpoint stable.

oncall-rotation: 12:45 checkpoint: all metrics within SLOs, queue normal. I’m closing the active page. If anyone sees regressions reopen. :white_check_mark:
